scope: Original category B curriculum planning; official topic support, not claim-level manuscript validation.

lessons.title: Your route into driving
lessons.objective: Build a personal preparation checklist covering entitlement, permits, supervised practice, risk training and examinations.
lessons.evidence_limit: Recheck dated licensing and examination requirements before publication.

lessons.title: Am I ready today?
lessons.objective: Decide whether to drive in scenarios involving tiredness, illness, medication, alcohol or other drugs, and explain a safer alternative.
lessons.evidence_limit: Syllabus scope for fatigue and medication; detailed impairment and medical claims need direct supporting guidance.

lessons.title: Pressure is a driving risk
lessons.objective: Identify how peers, impulses, confidence and personal circumstances can change a driving decision; rehearse a refusal or alternative.
lessons.evidence_limit: Syllabus scope, chapter 5; scenarios are original teaching exercises, not validated psychological predictions.

lessons.title: Plan the journey before the ignition
lessons.objective: Compare route, departure time, transport mode and passenger choices for safety, accessibility and environmental impact.
lessons.evidence_limit: Syllabus chapter 4 supports scope; route-specific restrictions must be checked separately.

self_assessment.objective: After the module scenario, identify one uncertain decision, explain its possible consequences, and choose an official reference or supervised practice activity to address it.

modules.title: Prepare a car that is ready

lessons.title: Know what the controls tell you
lessons.objective: Explain the purpose of core controls, warning indicators, braking and steering systems, and identify when further instructions are needed.
lessons.evidence_limit: Practical-test and syllabus scope; vehicle-specific operation and warning responses remain unverified.

lessons.title: A check before moving
lessons.objective: Organise a safety check of tyres, lights, visibility and vehicle condition, and distinguish a defect from a reason to seek help.
lessons.evidence_limit: Detailed maintenance procedures and defect thresholds require further evidence.

lessons.title: Protect everyone inside
lessons.objective: Select appropriate restraint arrangements in adult and child passenger scenarios and explain how belts, headrests and airbags work together.
lessons.evidence_limit: Verify age, height, seat-position exceptions and manufacturer-dependent arrangements before teaching specifics.

lessons.title: Move with control
lessons.objective: Plan observation and control for starting, stopping, reversing, hill starts and turning; explain the need for supervised practical practice.
lessons.evidence_limit: Official assessment scope; a text lesson cannot establish practical competence.

self_assessment.objective: After the module scenario, identify one uncertain decision, explain its possible consequences, and choose an official reference or supervised practice activity to address it.

lessons.title: Recognise what a sign asks
lessons.objective: Classify warning, priority, prohibition, mandatory and instruction signs and describe the decision each category prompts.
lessons.evidence_limit: Individual meanings and variants require step 4 verification.

lessons.title: Combine the instructions
lessons.objective: Interpret a sign with a supplementary panel, road marking or signal and identify when a police or guard instruction must be considered.
lessons.evidence_limit: The complete legal order of precedence and exceptions need direct provisions.

lessons.title: Find your way without rushing
lessons.objective: Use direction signs, symbols, facility and service signs to plan a route choice early, including walking and cycling destinations.
lessons.evidence_limit: Step 4 will select legible variants and English labels; category pages establish scope.

lessons.title: Leave room to respond
lessons.objective: Explain how observation, speed, reaction time, braking, grip and following space affect the options available in a developing hazard.
lessons.evidence_limit: Any formula or numerical example must state assumptions; it must not be presented as a guaranteed stopping distance.

self_assessment.objective: After the module scenario, identify one uncertain decision, explain its possible consequences, and choose an official reference or supervised practice activity to address it.

lessons.title: Decide who goes first
lessons.objective: Explain a junction decision using priority signs and right-hand priority, and recognise situations requiring further rule checks.
lessons.evidence_limit: Exit rules, turning duties, buses and special junction exceptions require direct supporting provisions.

lessons.title: Turn with a complete picture
lessons.objective: Plan observation, signalling, position and margins for turns and lane changes, accounting for blind spots and other road users.
lessons.evidence_limit: Practical-test scope; detailed positioning and lane rules require verification.

lessons.title: Crossings belong to people
lessons.objective: Distinguish pedestrian crossings, cycle passages and cycle crossings and explain the driver's responsibilities in a selected scenario.
lessons.evidence_limit: Check controlled versus uncontrolled crossings and exceptions against current guidance.

lessons.title: Choose a safe path through a roundabout
lessons.objective: Describe an approach, entry and exit plan that accounts for priority, lanes, signalling and people crossing nearby.
lessons.evidence_limit: Roundabout page supports entry duties; lane and signalling details need more evidence.

self_assessment.objective: After the module scenario, identify one uncertain decision, explain its possible consequences, and choose an official reference or supervised practice activity to address it.

lessons.title: See the person behind the movement
lessons.objective: Anticipate the needs of children, older people, wheelchair users, cyclists, riders and motorcyclists in street scenarios.
lessons.evidence_limit: Avoid stereotypes; detailed clearance requirements must be sourced before stating numbers.

lessons.title: When the street changes purpose
lessons.objective: Compare ordinary streets with walking-speed areas, pedestrian streets and cycle streets and choose a suitable driving response.
lessons.evidence_limit: Verify local restrictions and exceptions separately.

lessons.title: Choose a lawful place to stop
lessons.objective: Distinguish stopping from parking and interpret signs and time panels for a proposed parking place.
lessons.evidence_limit: General prohibitions, distances, dates, loading exceptions and permit scope require detailed official references.

lessons.title: Manoeuvre where people may appear
lessons.objective: Plan a low-speed parking or reversing manoeuvre with observation, space checks and a decision to stop when the view is insufficient.
lessons.evidence_limit: Assessment scope; no universal manoeuvre recipe or claim of practical proficiency.

self_assessment.objective: After the module scenario, identify one uncertain decision, explain its possible consequences, and choose an official reference or supervised practice activity to address it.

lessons.title: Read the rural road
lessons.objective: Identify risks from bends, crests, narrow roads, animals and slow vehicles and justify changes in speed and position.
lessons.evidence_limit: Detailed meeting and positioning rules need verification; animal behaviour cannot be guaranteed.

lessons.title: Is passing worth the risk?
lessons.objective: Compare staying behind with overtaking in a scenario using visibility, closing speed, space and the ability to abandon the attempt.
lessons.evidence_limit: Overtaking prohibitions and exceptions require direct legal support before manuscript drafting.

lessons.title: Join faster traffic calmly
lessons.objective: Plan a motorway entry, lane choice, separation and exit, including a safe response to a missed exit.
lessons.evidence_limit: Assessment scope; motorway and expressway legal restrictions need direct provisions.

lessons.title: Expect an interrupted route
lessons.objective: Interpret railway-crossing and roadworks information and plan a safe approach to changed lanes, queues or a blocked crossing.
lessons.evidence_limit: Separate normal crossing behaviour from an emergency; confirm current procedures and asset meanings.

self_assessment.objective: After the module scenario, identify one uncertain decision, explain its possible consequences, and choose an official reference or supervised practice activity to address it.

lessons.title: Drive within what you can see
lessons.objective: Choose a visibility and lighting strategy for darkness, fog and glare, considering both seeing and being seen.
lessons.evidence_limit: Verify lighting combinations and exceptions; avoid unsupported fixed visibility distances.

lessons.title: Grip is a changing resource
lessons.objective: Explain how rain, standing water, ice, snow, tyres and driver inputs can affect stability, steering and braking.
lessons.evidence_limit: Verify tyre dates, exemptions and limits; vehicle-specific recovery procedures remain out of scope until supported.

lessons.title: Protect your attention
lessons.objective: Recognise distraction, stress and fatigue in a journey scenario and choose a practical interruption or alternative travel plan.
lessons.evidence_limit: Separate communication-device law from broader safety advice; fatigue detail needs official corroboration.

lessons.title: Change the plan when risk grows
lessons.objective: Reassess a trip when weather, darkness, delays or passenger pressure accumulate and justify continuing, pausing or cancelling.
lessons.evidence_limit: Syllabus chapter 4 supports scope; no invented numerical risk thresholds.

self_assessment.objective: After the module scenario, identify one uncertain decision, explain its possible consequences, and choose an official reference or supervised practice activity to address it.

modules.title: Take responsibility for the vehicle and load

lessons.title: Understand what you may drive
lessons.objective: Use entitlement and vehicle-category information to decide what further checks a car or trailer combination requires.
lessons.evidence_limit: Verify all entitlement and weight thresholds before worked examples.

lessons.title: Make the load part of the safety check
lessons.objective: Distinguish weight terms, assess a proposed load and identify checks for securing cargo, towing capacity and trailer suitability.
lessons.evidence_limit: Dimensions, projections, coupling checks and equipment-specific rules require detailed verification.

lessons.title: Keep the car legally ready
lessons.objective: Build an ownership checklist covering registration, insurance, inspection and on-road or off-road status.
lessons.evidence_limit: Recheck deadlines, obligations and exemptions at manuscript verification.

lessons.title: Know what assistance cannot do
lessons.objective: Explain why safety systems and different powertrains do not remove the driver's duty to observe, control and recognise limitations.
lessons.evidence_limit: Detailed ABS, stability control, automated assistance and powertrain behaviours need explicit official evidence.

self_assessment.objective: After the module scenario, identify one uncertain decision, explain its possible consequences, and choose an official reference or supervised practice activity to address it.

modules.title: Reduce the impact of each journey

lessons.title: Look beyond the exhaust
lessons.objective: Compare climate, air-quality and noise effects of travel choices without assuming one vehicle has no environmental impact.
lessons.evidence_limit: Lifecycle comparisons and numerical emissions claims require additional evidence.

lessons.title: Use energy with foresight
lessons.objective: Plan smooth, anticipatory driving while preserving safety margins and explain how driving technique can affect energy use.
lessons.evidence_limit: Official assessment and syllabus scope; gear, coasting and vehicle-specific advice need verification.

lessons.title: Choose the journey as well as the car
lessons.objective: Compare combining trips, walking, cycling, public transport and driving for a realistic personal journey.
lessons.evidence_limit: Syllabus chapters 4–5 support transport choice; no invented savings or accessibility assumptions.

lessons.title: Check where the vehicle can go
lessons.objective: Find official environmental-zone information and identify what must be checked before entering a restricted area.
lessons.evidence_limit: Current local boundaries, signs and exemptions must be verified for each example.

self_assessment.objective: After the module scenario, identify one uncertain decision, explain its possible consequences, and choose an official reference or supervised practice activity to address it.

lessons.title: When the car cannot continue
lessons.objective: Compare the response to a breakdown on an ordinary road, a motorway and in a tunnel, explaining how the location changes the priorities.
lessons.evidence_limit: Do not generalise motorway evacuation advice to every tunnel incident; verify each procedure independently.

lessons.title: When someone may be hurt
lessons.objective: Identify scene-safety, emergency contact and first-aid learning needs following a collision, and distinguish knowledge from hands-on training.
lessons.evidence_limit: Syllabus chapter 3 mandates incident response and first aid; these sources do not establish a complete clinical first-aid procedure. Research required before instruction.

lessons.title: Explain a whole journey
lessons.objective: Review a mixed urban and rural scenario, justify decisions, identify missed hazards and propose safer alternatives.
lessons.evidence_limit: Original integrative exercise; not an official exam or a prediction of passing.

lessons.title: Make a realistic readiness plan
lessons.objective: Compare knowledge, practical performance and confidence, then create a plan for further supervised practice and accessible examination preparation.
lessons.evidence_limit: Use current official test guidance; self-assessment cannot certify readiness or entitlement.

self_assessment.objective: After the module scenario, identify one uncertain decision, explain its possible consequences, and choose an official reference or supervised practice activity to address it.
